interface.title: Radiowriter: Literature and drafting for Radiopaedia articles
interface.field: Radiology / medical imaging (evidence synthesis for encyclopaedia articles)
interface.stage_of_work: Literature search, screening and writing up (from finding the literature to drafting the article)
interface.what_it_is_for: Build and run PubMed searches for an imaging topic, rank the hits by journal rank or citations, save and screen them into named reading lists, then draft a structured Radiopaedia article that cites PMIDs, lint it and export numbered references and HTML.

data.note: No data was bundled or uploaded. Every record came from live PubMed searches made through the app. The search '"Joubert syndrome" AND MRI' with the Recent reviews filter returned 11 records. A Blocks query (Joubert syndrome OR molar tooth sign) AND a diffusion-weighted imaging block returned 6. The bundled SCImago CSV supplied SJR and quartiles. Unpaywall worked. Semantic Scholar citation fetching hung, so I stopped it and turned it off, and the citation columns stayed 'None'. Citations were resolved through radiopaedia.work. Downloading PDFs from PMC failed because the server's proxy was blocked.

tree.general: Find, screen and organise the literature on a clinical topic, then write a structured, referenced encyclopaedia article from it
tree.specific: Search PubMed for Joubert syndrome imaging, rank by SJR/quartile, save into reading lists, screen with read/flag and open access, then draft, lint and export a Radiopaedia article citing PMIDs
tree.note: Not covered by this run: keeping PDFs (the 3 Library tab: one PDF per article, matching a dropped-in PDF by DOI or title, the highlights checklist) and the study window that shows the Radiopaedia page next to a PDF. The README treats 'Keep the PDFs' as one of its four main sections (see docs/guide/library.md). The Library stayed at 0 PDFs because Save free PDF hit a proxy 403 and no test PDFs were available, and the study window needs pywebview, which was not installed. Ranking by citation count (Semantic Scholar) was also never shown working; only SJR and quartile ranking were.

features.name: Concept-block query builder
features.general: Build a boolean search one concept at a time: alternative wordings inside a concept are joined by OR, concepts are joined by AND, each term gets a field tag, and the exact query string is shown live
features.specific: ⛁ Blocks: type a wording, choose a Field (Title/Abstract…), ＋ Another wording, choose the Joined by operator, ＋ Add a block or ↺ Start over; the green preview shows e.g. ("Joubert syndrome"[tiab] OR "molar tooth sign"[tiab])
steps: Switch from One line to Blocks
Type the first wording of a concept and pick its field
Press ＋ Another wording and type a synonym
Optionally ＋ Add a block for a second concept
Read the assembled query under 'The search terms this builds'
serves_tasks: Build a structured concept-by-concept query instead

features.name: Controlled-vocabulary term expander
features.general: Pick named methods from a catalogue and have each expanded into its thesaurus descriptors and free-text synonyms, preview the clause, and add the terms to the query as a new concept
features.specific: 🩻 Imaging modalities (e.g. MRI › Diffusion-weighted imaging): type to filter, preview each clause, Where do they go = a new block joined with AND, Add N modalities
steps: Open the modalities panel
Type to filter and choose one or more entries
Read the clause preview for each choice
Choose where the terms go and add them to the query
serves_tasks: Build a structured concept-by-concept query instead

features.name: Heading-to-search-strategy generator
features.general: Turn the sections planned for a document (such as epidemiology or a particular imaging method) into search clauses, with a choice of thesaurus-only, keywords-only or both, so each section gets its own literature search
features.specific: ⌗ Radiopaedia headings: choose a Kind of article (Disease, Fracture, Sign, Device, Comparison…), pick headings such as Epidemiology and MRI, switch Terms between MeSH + keywords / MeSH only / Keywords only and watch each clause change
steps: Open the headings panel and choose the kind of article
Pick one or more headings
Read the MeSH plus keyword clause for each heading
Switch Terms to MeSH only (or Keywords only) and see the clauses shorten
serves_tasks: Generate search terms from the sections of the planned article

features.name: Search filter presets with custom override
features.general: Apply a preset bundle of limits (recent reviews, full text, language, humans) or switch to a form that exposes each limit (date window, text availability, language, age, species/sex, publication type), with a one-line summary of what is applied
features.specific: Filters: ★ Recent reviews / No filters / Custom; Custom shows Publication date (Last N years or Between two years), Abstract/Free full text/Full text/Associated data, Article language, Age, Humans/Other animals/Female/Male, Exclude preprints, MEDLINE, Kind of publication (Any / Publication type (NLM) / Search filter (ISSG)); '?' explains the preset
steps: Choose a preset or Custom
Adjust individual limits such as Kind of publication = Any
Read the summary line and final query
Run the search
serves_tasks: Run a free-text search with a preset filter
Build a structured concept-by-concept query instead
